# 'toy' Dialect

The capstone Toy dialect.

A tiny `f64` arithmetic dialect: constants, `add`/`mul`/`sub` (all
implementing `BinaryArithOpInterface`), a side-effecting `print`, a
fixed-size array type and a 2-D shape attribute. Its ops are folded by the
`-toy-fold` pass.

[TOC]

## Operations

### `toy.add` (::toy::AddOp)

_F64 addition_


Syntax:

```
operation ::= `toy.add` $lhs `,` $rhs attr-dict
```

Adds two `f64` values. Folded by `-toy-fold` when both operands are
`toy.constant`s (DRR pattern in this file).

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`

Interfaces: `BinaryArithOpInterface`, `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{}`

#### Operands:

| Operand | Description |
| :-----: | ----------- |
| `lhs` | 64-bit float
| `rhs` | 64-bit float

#### Results:

| Result | Description |
| :----: | ----------- |
| `result` | 64-bit float


### `toy.constant` (::toy::ConstantOp)

_A constant f64 value_


Syntax:

```
operation ::= `toy.constant` $value attr-dict
```

Materializes an `f64` constant:

```mlir
%c = toy.constant 1.0
```

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{}`

## Attributes

### ShapeAttr

a static 2-D shape

Syntax:

```
#toy.shape<
  int64_t,   # rows
  int64_t   # cols
>
```

Rows and columns of a matrix, e.g. `#toy.shape<3 x 4>`.

#### Parameters:

| Parameter | C++ type | Description |
| :-------: | :-------: | ----------- |
| rows | `int64_t` | number of rows |
| cols | `int64_t` | number of columns |

## Types

### ArrayType

a fixed-size array type

Syntax:

```
!toy.array<
  int64_t,   # size
  ::mlir::Type   # elementType
>
```

`!toy.array<N x T>`: exactly `N` elements of type `T`.

#### Parameters:

| Parameter | C++ type | Description |
| :-------: | :-------: | ----------- |
| size | `int64_t` | number of elements |
| elementType | `::mlir::Type` | element type |
